FACTIONS.name: Mercantile Compact
FACTIONS.description: Chartered harbor syndicates and convoy wardens keeping the Shatter Coast sea-lanes open with disciplined gunboats.
FACTIONS.doctrine: Balanced coastal patrol hulls, reliable rapid-fire deck guns, and high-endurance convoy escorts.

FACTIONS.name: Cinder Forge Directorate
FACTIONS.description: Foundry barons and fuel refiners operating out of volcanic calderas, arming slab-sided iron hulls with heavy ordnance.
FACTIONS.doctrine: Thick riveted armor plating, high-caliber cannons, siege rocket batteries, and heavy damage control pumps.

FACTIONS.name: Reedwater Commune
FACTIONS.description: Shallow-draft marsh navigators, hydroplane builders, and agrarian cooperatives defending the southern channels.
FACTIONS.doctrine: High-speed planing hulls, tight turning radii, torpedo ambushes, and agile flanking tactics.

FACTIONS.name: Shatter Reef Raiders
FACTIONS.description: Breakaway blockade flotillas and reef scavengers seizing toll narrows from fortified eastern sea-stacks.
FACTIONS.doctrine: Aggressive wolfpack interceptors, salvo rockets, overcharged engines, and high-alpha strike craft.

HULLS.name: Tinwake Skiff
HULLS.description: Riveted utility harbor skiff fitted with a pintle heavy autocannon. Cheap, nimble, and dependable in a scrape.

HULLS.name: Bilgewater Punt
HULLS.description: Patchwork reef skiff stripped of bulkheads for speed. Common among outer-channel lookouts and blockade scouts.

HULLS.name: Lantern Ward Skiff
HULLS.description: Up-engined customs skiff with twin-fed rotary carbines and reinforced bilge stringers.

HULLS.name: Marsh Dart Hydro
HULLS.description: Shallow-step hydroplane cutter that skims across shoal water to run down smugglers.

HULLS.name: Scabfin Cutter
HULLS.description: Twin-screw raider cutter with saw-toothed bow fenders and rapid-fire casemate repeaters.

HULLS.name: Galeblade Interceptor
HULLS.description: Supercharged commune pursuit craft built to outflank heavy flotillas and shred exposed gun crews.

HULLS.name: Silt Runner Lugger
HULLS.description: Broad-beamed estuary freighter with concealed deck guns and cavernous dry-cargo holds.

HULLS.name: Grapnel Blockade Runner
HULLS.description: Fast contraband runner carrying a low-velocity deck howitzer and reinforced smuggling lockers.

HULLS.name: Sovereign Armed Packet
HULLS.description: Armored Compact treasury packet capable of hauling bulk high-value cargo right through a cordon.

HULLS.name: Breakwater Patrol Sloop
HULLS.description: Sturdy brass-trimmed sloop mounting a quick-firing bow pounder for coastal convoy duty.

HULLS.name: Ashwake Escort Corvette
HULLS.description: Welded foundry corvette with turtleback armored decking and a high-velocity turret gun.

HULLS.name: Vanguard Line Corvette
HULLS.description: Fleet-standard Compact escort vessel balancing rangefinder gunnery with compartmentalized flood control.

HULLS.name: Fen Stinger Torpedo Launch
HULLS.description: Low-profile marsh launch carrying twin compressed-air drop collars for close-range hull breaches.

HULLS.name: Tallowfin Torpedo Boat
HULLS.description: Raider wolfpack strike craft built around centerline reloads that crack heavy armor belts open.

HULLS.name: Manta Flotilla Leader
HULLS.description: Premier hydro-foil torpedo destroyer capable of devastating dreadnought formations at high speed.

HULLS.name: Slagclast River Gunboat
HULLS.description: Casemate ironclad gunboat built to trade broadsides in narrow industrial straits.

HULLS.name: Bellows Siege Gunboat
HULLS.description: Twin-turret foundry monitor whose heavy armor shrugs off small-caliber gunfire.

HULLS.name: Furnace Sovereign Monitor
HULLS.description: Floating steel bastion mounting a long-barrel coastal siege rifle and high-volume steam bilge ejectors.

HULLS.name: Sparkrack Rocket Scow
HULLS.description: Converted ore barge fitted with angled incendiary rocket rails that saturate enemy decks with fire.

HULLS.name: Pyreclast Rocket Monitor
HULLS.description: Armored bombardment platform firing spin-stabilized thermite rockets across long open-water lanes.

HULLS.name: Hellbore Salvo Cruiser
HULLS.description: Heavy raider battery vessel built to rain salvos from extreme range before closing for the kill.

HULLS.name: Cobalt Commodore Frigate
HULLS.description: Command frigate equipped with armored sponsons, dual diesel-turbines, and brigade damage-control teams.

HULLS.name: Bastion Armored Cruiser
HULLS.description: Heavy fleet flagship of the Compact, built to anchor battle lines and absorb punishing salvos.

HULLS.name: Shatter Throne Dreadnought
HULLS.description: Apex capital warship of the Shatter Coast: triple-belted krupp steel, twin siege turrets, and massive bilge manifolds.

HULLS.name: Kelpnet Dory
HULLS.description: Open Reedwater net dory with a hand reel, salvage drum and one light defense gun. Its short planked hull and single propulsion assembly keep the physical building bill small.

HULLS.name: Brinehook Longliner
HULLS.description: Compact working launch with a long stern, line davit and paired drums under a customs canopy. Extra planking and bilge equipment support a modest catch hold.

HULLS.name: Mother Gull Trawler
HULLS.description: Broad estuary catamaran with a cross-beam work deck, twin net reels and covered net stacks. Two propulsion assemblies move the timber-heavy trawling hull; its single light gun is for defense.

HULLS.name: Fenhopper Lighter
HULLS.description: Flat estuary lighter carrying lashed bale stacks on both hulls beneath a low span bridge. Cargo framing favors timber and logs over armor; one light gun leaves the other sockets optional.

HULLS.name: Tideledger Coaster
HULLS.description: Long coastal catamaran with a packet prow crest and bonded strongboxes. Hull-area planking and twin propulsion assemblies dominate the yard bill rather than military armor.

HULLS.name: Fourport Packet
HULLS.description: Civilian packet with a high packet-house bridge, broad cargo framing and covered manifests. More hold space than the Sovereign Armed Packet trades armor and ordnance for planks, pumps and cargo access.

HULLS.name: Brasswind Motor-Galleon
HULLS.description: Wide motor-driven cargo galleon with a packet house and cargo derrick masts, without working sails. Three propulsion assemblies and extensive timber framing make the largest civilian building bill; only one light defense gun is installed.

HULLS.name: Seepoil Tanker Barge
HULLS.description: Civilian foundry barge with a low turtleback wheelhouse, manifold banks and secured casks. High pump capacity demands copper, supplies and paid mechanics; the hold uses ordinary finite cargo custody.

HULLS.name: Blackwater Fleet Tanker
HULLS.description: Long civilian fleet tanker with a practical wheelhouse and manifold runs along both rails. Its heavy pumping fit and three propulsion assemblies need substantial copper, mechanics and engineering supervision, with no automatic fuel delivery.

HULLS.name: Gullwing Daysailer
HULLS.description: Motor hydrofoil pleasure launch with a stepped cockpit, trim cells and coiled docking ropes. Its numerical crew are sailors; speed-driven propulsion takes precedence over a tiny cargo hold.

HULLS.name: Lacquered Osprey Cruiser
HULLS.description: Cabin cruiser with an interceptor canopy, signal tube and fitted lockers. Cabin joinery adds four plank bundles and three repair kits to the derived hull recipe, including their existing paid supply chains and shipwright work.

HULLS.name: Aurelian Viceroy Yacht
HULLS.description: High-ranking civilian yacht with a commodore tower, signal wings and household cabins. Eight extra plank bundles and six repair kits fund the fitted interior through existing material and labor bills; household staff count within its numerical crew.

PORTS.name: Brass Haven
PORTS.description: The Western Compact anchorage sheltered behind Lantern Cay, bustling with coastal packet boats and repair slips.

PORTS.name: Kelp Reach
PORTS.description: Stilt-built curing wharves along Kelpback Shoal where fast hydroplane cutters patrol the western sound.

PORTS.name: Sawtooth Mill
PORTS.description: Cliffside water-mills cutting dense ironwood logs floated down from Sawtooth Crag.

PORTS.name: Silt Hollow
PORTS.description: Polder farms and floating granaries feeding the southern archipelago from the lee of Verdigris Atoll.

PORTS.name: Cinder Quay
PORTS.description: Soot-darkened blast furnaces on the western shelf of Cinder Crown casting heavy turret steel and munitions.

PORTS.name: Anvil Dock
PORTS.description: Deepwater drydocks on eastern Cinder Crown where armored monitors and turbine engines are assembled.

PORTS.name: Reedwater Floats
PORTS.description: Lashed pontoon markets off Kettle Fen Isle serving as the neutral crossroad between west and east.

PORTS.name: Naphtha Bay
PORTS.description: Cracking towers and tank piers beneath Oilstone Bluff supplying high-grade marine distillate.

PORTS.name: Rust Anchorage
PORTS.description: Chain-guarded sea caves on the western approach to Shatter Bastion where raiders refit prize hulls.

PORTS.name: Shatter Spire
PORTS.description: The iron-ringed citadel at the southern point of Shatter Bastion from which the Raider Admiral commands the blockade.

MISSIONS.title: 1. Clear the Lantern Narrows
MISSIONS.description: A lone Raider lookout skiff is harassing fishing boats between Brass Haven and Kelp Reach. Sortie in your patrol skiff and sink the raider scout.

MISSIONS.title: 2. Patching Supplies to Sawtooth Mill
MISSIONS.description: Sawtooth Mill needs emergency hull-patching supplies to reopen its repair slipway. Run the blockade cutters guarding the northern sound.

MISSIONS.title: 3. Hunt the Grain Reavers
MISSIONS.description: Raider outriders led by a Scabfin Cutter have been burning grain barges outside Silt Hollow. Track down and destroy their patrol.

MISSIONS.title: 4. Break the Foundry Cordon
MISSIONS.description: Two heavy raider blockade runners have mined the western channel into Cinder Quay. Smash their cordon so Compact convoys can reach the blast furnaces.

MISSIONS.title: 5. Munitions for Reedwater Floats
MISSIONS.description: Deliver a critical crate shipment of foundry ammunition from Cinder Quay to the commune defenders at Reedwater Floats through a three-ship ambush pack.

MISSIONS.title: 6. Silence the Strait Bombardiers
MISSIONS.description: A renegade gunboat division has seized the eastern approach to Anvil Dock, shelling every shipyard tug in sight. Eliminate the strike group.

MISSIONS.title: 7. Reclaim the Naphtha Tanker Lane
MISSIONS.description: Secure the fuel lifelines at Naphtha Bay by defeating the Raider vanguard squadron of rocket monitors and torpedo boats.

MISSIONS.title: 8. Assault on Shatter Spire
MISSIONS.description: Lead the combined coastal flotilla into the eastern reef citadel and sink the Raider Admiral aboard the Shatter Throne Dreadnought and its two heavy escorts.
